description: Implementation of DefaultEntityQueryService class providing entity query functionalities, including data retrieval, alarm data processing, and key fetching, within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: DefaultEntityQueryService
classes.description: Service class implementing entity query operations, including data retrieval, alarm processing, and key fetching within the Thingsboard platform.

methods.name: countEntitiesByQuery
methods.description: Counts entities matching the specified query for a given security user.

methods.name: findEntityDataByQuery
methods.description: Retrieves entity data based on the provided query, resolving dynamic values in key filters.

methods.name: resolveDynamicValuesInPredicates
methods.description: Recursively resolves dynamic values within key filter predicates.

methods.name: setResolvedValue
methods.description: Sets the resolved value for a predicate based on dynamic attribute data.

methods.name: resolveDynamicValue
methods.description: Resolves a dynamic value from attribute service based on source type and attribute name.

methods.name: findAlarmDataByQuery
methods.description: Retrieves alarm data matching the query, including associated entity data.

methods.name: countAlarmsByQuery
methods.description: Counts alarms matching the specified query.

methods.name: buildEntityDataQuery (AlarmCountQuery)
methods.description: Builds an EntityDataQuery object for alarm count queries.

methods.name: buildEntityDataQuery (AlarmDataQuery)
methods.description: Builds an EntityDataQuery object for alarm data queries.

methods.name: getKeysByQuery
methods.description: Fetches available entity keys (timeseries and attributes) based on a query and scope.

methods.name: findEntityIdsByQueryAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously finds entity IDs matching a query.

methods.name: resolveAttributeScopes
methods.description: Determines effective attribute scopes based on requested scopes and entity types.

methods.name: fetchTimeseriesKeys
methods.description: Fetches timeseries keys for entities, optionally including samples.

methods.name: fetchAttributeKeys
methods.description: Fetches attribute keys for entities within a specific scope, optionally including samples.

methods.name: assembleResult
methods.description: Assembles the final AvailableEntityKeysV2 object from futures.

methods.name: toKeyInfos
methods.description: Converts KvEntries to a list of KeyInfo objects.

methods.name: toKeySample
methods.description: Converts a KvEntry to a KeySample object, including timestamp and value.
